academyx.paramLead: Heating, changeover and cooling times for socket welding according to DVS 2207-11 (heating element 250–270 °C), the basis shown practically in the videos.
academyx.paramNote: Reference values according to DVS 2207-11 for PP at 250–270 °C heating element temperature. The welding machine manufacturer's specifications and the processing instructions are binding; in case of doubt: watch the video, check parameters on the device.
academyx.stepLead: Each procedure has its dimension range, and five steps that determine the connection's quality.

procs.t: Manual socket welding, up to d63

steps.d: Cut pipe at right angles, cleanly deburr and chamfer, use pipe cutter from the K Aqua tool range.
Mark insertion depth on the pipe according to the table (e.g. 14 mm for d20), it defines the joining zone.
Push pipe into the heating bush, fitting onto the heating spigot, slide on simultaneously and keep the heating time exactly.
Join axially within the changeover time. Never twist: twisting destroys the plasticized structure.
Fix connection for a few seconds, then wait the cooling time before mechanical load is applied.
Cut to length, deburr, mark welding depth, the basic rules remain identical.
The machine holds both joining partners coaxially, offset and tilt errors are mechanically excluded.
Heating bush and spigot according to DVS reference values; the machine maintains position and time reproducibly.
The feed joins axially and evenly, the key to constant quality, especially for d75 to d125.
Only unclamp and process further after the cooling time has elapsed.
Peel and clean the pipe surface in the joining zone, oxide skin and dirt prevent welding.
Mark depth on the pipe, push pipe into the fitting up to the stop.
Use holding clamps, the fitting must not be under bending stress during welding.
The device energizes the embedded heating coils in the fitting, parameters come from the fitting, not from feeling.
Only move or load after the specified cooling time, check control indicators on the fitting.

procs.t: Butt Fusion, large dimensions up to d630

steps.d: Face both pipe ends in the machine until continuous shavings appear, plane parallelism is mandatory.
Maximum offset 10% of the wall thickness, every millimeter counts at d630.
Equalize under pressure until a bead forms, then heat through without pressure, times according to DVS 2207-11.
Remove the heating element swiftly and bring the ends together under defined joining pressure.
The joining pressure remains until the end of the cooling time, then the homogeneous, permanently tight string is created.

gloss: SDR
Standard Dimension Ratio = Outer diameter divided by wall thickness (d/s). Smaller SDR = thicker wall = higher nominal pressure.
PN
Nominal pressure in bar at 20 °C over the design horizon, SDR 6 corresponds to PN 20, SDR 17 corresponds to PN 6.
d / di / s
Outer diameter / Inner diameter / Wall thickness in millimeters, di = d − 2s.
PP-R
Polypropylene Random Copolymer, the proven standard material for drinking water installations.
PPRCT
PP-R with modified crystal structure ('Crystallinity Temperature'), more temperature and pressure reserve with the same wall.
K-Fiber / GF
Glass fiber reinforced multilayer construction, reduces thermal expansion to about a quarter.
Socket welding
Socket Fusion: pipe and fitting are plasticized via heating bush and spigot and joined together.
Electrofusion
Electrofusion: embedded heating coils in the fitting generate the welding heat, parameter-controlled.
Butt Welding
Butt Fusion: plane-parallel pipe ends are heated on the heating element and joined under pressure, standard up to d630.

posts.teaser: The ISO management system of KWT GmbH now includes quality, environment, and energy, DAkkS-accredited.
body: Since October 2025, the management system of KWT GmbH is triple certified: ISO 9001:2015 for quality, ISO 14001:2015 for environment, and ISO 50001:2018 for energy. The certificates are issued by a DAkkS-accredited certification body and are valid until October 2028.

For purchasing and compliance, this means: documented, auditable processes from extruder to shipping. The lived GENAU management system already met the requirements of DIN EN ISO 14001 and 50001, the audit makes it externally verifiable.
Both certificate versions (DE/EN) are available for download; the complete audit package can be compiled in the Trust Centre.

posts.t: Continuously marked: Traceability from the extruder
posts.teaser: Every K-Aqua pipe bears a continuous marking directly from the extrusion process.
body: With up to 14,000 meters of pipe per day and line, traceability is not optional: every pipe is continuously marked during the extrusion process, with the details planners and inspectors need on site.

The marking links the physical product to its batch and the quality assurance test reports. What is printed on the pipe can be traced back to the test labouratory, a component of the QA manual that auditors can request in the Trust Centre.

posts.teaser: From flare gas to drinking water pipe: the short material history of polypropylene.
body: Polypropylene is produced from gases that were previously flared off uselessly, its material use reduces air pollution at the source. As an engineering plastic, PP is unusually resistant to solvents, alkalis, and acids and forms complex geometries in injection molding.

In a pipe, the inner surface counts most: with 0.007 mm roughness, pressure loss remains minimal, and biofilm and incrustation find almost no hold. Add to this a thermal conductivity of 0.24 W/(m·K), hot water stays hot without the pipe insulating against itself.
PPRCT pushes the limits even further: the modified crystal structure brings more temperature and pressure reserve, SDR 7.4 holds 70 °C at 10 bar in continuous operation.

posts.t: Brass meets Polypropylene: Transitions into existing systems
posts.teaser: Renovation almost always means a system change, transition pieces with brass threads make it clean.
body: Hardly any project starts on a green field: existing pipes made of copper or galvanized steel must be connected. For this purpose, there are transition pieces with embedded brass female or male threads, the threaded side connects to the existing metal, the PP side is materially welded.

This allows section-by-section renovation: corroded lines are replaced, functioning ones remain, and the corrosion problem doesn't migrate to the new system. Screw connections make the joint detachable if necessary, such as at valves and water meters.
